method: Read both complete acquired bodies and verify recomputed SHA-256 against receipts; compare with the separately reviewed concept source
observations: Both bodies retain the preference for structured direct tools where suitable, supported desktop platforms, preview status and reviewable session activity; capability examples are not authorization or runtime receipts.
Default disablement, explicit enablement and surface-specific tool permission settings remain separate from macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording prerequisites.
Persistent application grants are local and shared between app and CLI on the same computer. Removing a saved grant changes future sessions, not already-granted access in a running session.
Explicit denial and enterprise-managed disablement override automatic/saved approval and local enablement respectively.
CLI and app interruption instructions differ. Operation interruption is not inferred to revoke session access; the separately reviewed app how-to describes session termination for revocation.

Both retain risks from UI variation, timing, repeated actions, unexpected visible content and sensitive third-party information, plus result/target/permission review before consequential actions and avoidance of persistent high-impact application grants.
The reviewed bodies differ in version-prefixed links rather than these operative instructions. Managed-policy and responsible-use link content remains a separate review dependency.
Resolved labels and consistent text do not identify a deployment-source commit, prove account availability or exercise the described controls.
remaining: Independent atomic claim and omission reconciliation
Linked enterprise managed-settings and responsible-use review
